about.description:
This software supports the Nuand bladeRF and bladeRF Micro USB 3.0 Software Defined Radio (SDR) devices:

  - `libbladerf2` contains the library for bladeRF devices
  - `libbladerf` contains the development files for compiling against the bladeRF library
  - `libbladerf-python` contains the Python bindings for the bladeRF library
  - `bladerf` package contains command line tools for using the devices

For Linux users of `bladerf`, you will likely want to link the provided udev rule into your system installation in order for the hardware to have the correct permissions:

    sudo ln -s $CONDA_PREFIX/lib/udev/rules.d/88-nuand-bladerf1.rules /etc/udev/rules.d/
    sudo ln -s $CONDA_PREFIX/lib/udev/rules.d/88-nuand-bladerf2.rules /etc/udev/rules.d/
    sudo ln -s $CONDA_PREFIX/lib/udev/rules.d/88-nuand-bootloader.rules /etc/udev/rules.d/
    sudo udevadm control --reload
    sudo udevadm trigger

Then, make sure your user account belongs to the plugdev group in order to be able to access your device:

    sudo usermod -a -G plugdev <user>

You may have to restart for this change to take effect.

raw_meta_yaml:
schema_version: 1

context:
  version: "2025.10"
  lib_major_version: "2"
  build: 0
  fsk_git_rev: fb903684036217b9db9dcd6be8007548e12a377e

recipe:
  name: bladerf-split
  version: ${{ version }}

source:
  - url: https://github.com/Nuand/bladeRF/archive/refs/tags/${{ version }}.tar.gz
    sha256: f7a63f7ad53cf3478dc60cc476b377020a7c256ef37640b1a4fa715cd9784b23
    patches:
      - 0001-Add-required-ad9361-files-directly.patch
      - 0002-Rename-bladeRF.dll-to-bladeRF-2.dll-on-Windows.patch
      - 0003-Modify-Python-bindings-to-load-major-versioned-libbl.patch
      - 0004-Add-an-option-for-bundling-external-libraries-on-Win.patch
      - 0005-Fix-test-linking-with-rt-when-glibc-2.17-is-used.patch
  - git: https://github.com/Nuand/bladeRF-fsk.git
    rev: ${{ fsk_git_rev }}
    target_directory: host/utilities/bladeRF-fsk

build:
  number: ${{ build }}

outputs:
  - staging:
      name: bladerf-build
    requirements:
      build:
        - ${{ compiler("c") }}
        - ${{ stdlib("c") }}
        - ${{ compiler("cxx") }}
        - cmake
        - ninja
        - pkg-config
      host:
        - if: unix
          then: libcurl
        - if: unix
          then: libedit
        - libusb
        - if: unix
          then: ncurses

  - package:
      name: libbladerf${{ lib_major_version }}
    inherit:
      from: bladerf-build
      run_exports: false
    build:
      files:
        include:
          - if: linux
            then: lib/libbladeRF.so.${{ lib_major_version }}
          - if: osx
            then: lib/libbladeRF.${{ lib_major_version }}.dylib
          - if: win
            then: Library/bin/bladeRF-${{ lib_major_version }}.dll
    requirements:
      build:
        - ${{ compiler("c") }}
        - ${{ stdlib("c") }}
      host:
        - libusb
    tests:
      - package_contents:
          strict: true
          files:
            - if: linux
              then: lib/libbladeRF.so.${{ lib_major_version }}
            - if: osx
              then: lib/libbladeRF.${{ lib_major_version }}.dylib
            - if: win
              then: Library/bin/bladeRF-${{ lib_major_version }}.dll

  - package:
      name: libbladerf
    inherit:
      from: bladerf-build
      run_exports: false
    build:
      files:
        include:
          - ${{ "Library/" if win }}include/**
          - ${{ "Library/" if win }}lib/**
          - ${{ "Library/" if win }}share/**
        exclude:
          - if: linux
            then: lib/libbladeRF.so.${{ lib_major_version }}
          - if: osx
            then: lib/libbladeRF.${{ lib_major_version }}.dylib
          - if: linux
            then: lib/udev/**
    requirements:
      build:
        - ${{ compiler("c") }}
        - ${{ stdlib("c") }}
      host:
        - ${{ pin_subpackage("libbladerf" + lib_major_version, exact=True) }}
      run:
        - ${{ pin_subpackage("libbladerf" + lib_major_version, exact=True) }}
      run_exports:
        - ${{ pin_subpackage("libbladerf" + lib_major_version, upper_bound=None) }}
    tests:
      - package_contents:
          strict: true
          include:
            - bladeRF1.h
            - bladeRF2.h
            - libbladeRF.h
          lib:
            - if: unix
              then: bladeRF
          files:
            - if: win
              then: Library/lib/bladeRF.lib
            - ${{ "Library/" if win }}lib/pkgconfig/libbladeRF.pc
            - ${{ "Library/" if win }}share/cmake/bladeRF/bladeRFConfig*.cmake

  - package:
      name: libbladerf-python
    build:
      string: py_${{ build }}
      noarch: python
      script: python -m pip install -vv host/libraries/libbladeRF_bindings/python
      python:
        entry_points:
          - bladerf-tool = bladerf._tool:main
    requirements:
      build:
        # cross-compilation dependencies
        - if: build_platform != target_platform
          then: python ${{ python_min }}.*
        - if: build_platform != target_platform
          then: cross-python_${{ target_platform }}
      host:
        - cffi
        - ${{ pin_subpackage("libbladerf" + lib_major_version, exact=True) }}
        - pip
        - python ${{ python_min }}.*
        - setuptools
      run:
        - cffi
        - libbladerf${{ lib_major_version }} ${{ version }}.*
        - python >=${{ python_min }}
    tests:
      - python:
          imports:
            - bladerf
          pip_check: false
          python_version:
            - ${{ python_min }}.*
            - "*"
      - requirements:
          run:
            - python ${{ python_min }}.*
        script:
          - bladerf-tool version

  - package:
      name: bladerf
    inherit:
      from: bladerf-build
      run_exports: false
    build:
      files:
        include:
          - ${{ "Library/" if win }}bin/**
          - if: linux
            then: lib/udev/**
    requirements:
      build:
        - ${{ compiler("c") }}
        - ${{ stdlib("c") }}
      host:
        - ${{ pin_subpackage("libbladerf" + lib_major_version, exact=True) }}
        - if: unix
          then: libcurl
        - if: unix
          then: libedit
        - if: unix
          then: ncurses
      run:
        - ${{ pin_subpackage("libbladerf" + lib_major_version, exact=True) }}
        - ${{ pin_subpackage("libbladerf-python", exact=True) }}
    tests:
      - package_contents:
          strict: true
          bin:
            - bladeRF-cli
            - if: unix
              then: bladeRF-fsk
            - if: unix
              then: bladeRF-power
            - bladeRF-update
          files:
            - if: linux
              then: bin/.bladerf-post-link.sh
            - if: linux
              then: lib/udev/rules.d/88-nuand-bladerf1.rules
            - if: linux
              then: lib/udev/rules.d/88-nuand-bladerf2.rules
            - if: linux
              then: lib/udev/rules.d/88-nuand-bootloader.rules
      - script:
          - bladeRF-cli --version
          - bladeRF-cli --lib-version
          - if: unix
            then: bladeRF-fsk --help
          - if: unix
            then: bladeRF-power --help
          - bladeRF-update -h
